storage_policy.mode: LOCAL-FIRST ONLY — no MongoDB, no FastAPI, no cloud database, no account, no login
storage_policy.engine: IndexedDB (promise-wrapped repo layer in frontend/src/lib/repo.ts) so the app works fully offline
storage_policy.cloud_sync_readiness: All reads/writes go through a single repository + store layer (lib/repo.ts + lib/store.ts); a future cloud sync can hook the same interface without touching UI code. DO NOT implement sync now.
storage_policy.demo_data: Seeded on first run, labeled DATI DI PROVA, removable with ONE button; after removal the app is completely empty

compliance_language.disclaimer: Stima indicativa, non sostituisce la busta paga.
compliance_language.surcharges: All percentages (straordinario, festivo, notturno, domenicale, reperibilità, trasferta) are user-configurable in Impostazioni — never universal values

instructions_to_main_agent: LOCAL-FIRST ONLY: build the whole app in the farm-ts frontend/src structure with Vite + React 19 + Tailwind CSS v4 + lucide-react. Do NOT use MongoDB, FastAPI, any /api endpoint, accounts or login. Persist everything (giornate, impostazioni, config) in IndexedDB via lib/repo.ts + lib/store.ts; the app must work completely offline.
Keep the architecture ready for future cloud sync: all data mutations flow through the single store layer; do not implement sync now.

Seed realistic Italian demo data (Mario Rossi, Edil Costruzioni S.r.l., current month) with varied days: standard 8h, long overtime day, night shift, Saturday, festivo, ferie, malattia, permesso, riposo, reperibilità, trasferta. Banner DATI DI PROVA with ONE button 'Rimuovi dati di prova' that empties the app completely.
Live net hour calculation (fine - inizio - pausa) with midnight-crossing support (21:00–05:00 = 8h).

Exports: CSV with Italian Excel separator (;) + BOM, one-tap JSON backup export/import in Impostazioni, and a simple generated PDF titled 'Riepilogo Presenze e Stima Retribuzione' — never use the word 'Cedolino'.
Any net amount is labeled 'Stima netto'; show the disclaimer 'Stima indicativa, non sostituisce la busta paga.' wherever an estimate appears.
Make all surcharge percentages user-editable in Impostazioni (straordinario, festivo, notturno, domenicale, reperibilità, trasferta) with defaults at 0; no universal/legal defaults.
Ship an installable Android PWA: manifest.webmanifest, theme-color, icons, and a service worker registered on the frontend (passthrough in dev, cache-first for static assets in production builds).
All text MUST be natural, friendly Italian: dates GG/MM/AAAA, 24h times, currency in Euro with Italian formatting.
